title: Bounded source ingest adapter template

slots.description: Source-specific search or filter policy edge kind, e.g. ClinicSearchPolicy for HRSA or POITagSpec for Overpass; the instantiated adapter must validate it before any request is issued.
Typed record-set edge kind the instantiated adapter emits, e.g. HRSASiteRecordSet or OSMPOIRecordSet; rows must carry stable record ids and source_id provenance.

proof_requirements: schema_validation of the search policy payload before any request
snapshot_meta discloses retrieved_mode (fixture_synthetic vs live) on every response
attribution string present when the source license requires it
known_failure_modes: source pagination truncates result sets silently when page limits are not exhausted
rate limits or outages return partial data that looks like a small-but-valid result set
